newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil finally kicks off Meridional sell-off.
newsitem.headline: Brazil finally kicks off Meridional sell-off.

text.p: Brazil's National Monetary Council (CMN) Thursday kicked off the privatization process for federal bank Meridional by approving the conditions for pre-qualifying for the bid, said a Central Bank official.
Central Bank Director of Controls Alkimar Moura told reporters there would be no restriction on foreign banks bidding for the Porto Allegre-based bank.
"This is the first step in the privatization," Moura said. "Up to 100 percent of control can be snapped up by foreign institutions."
He declined to comment on a likely date for the sell-off.
Meridional was taken off the privatization list last year after failed attempts to sell the bank. But the government recently placed the bank back on the list.
